app.name: Oewang
app.tagline: Track daily money without manual spreadsheets.
app.description: Oewang is a modern financial OS. Manage spending, track transactions, read receipts, and gain real-time visibility into your finances.

chat.title: Assistant
chat.no_conversations_body: Start one and it shows up here.
chat.empty_body: The assistant reads this workspace's transactions, wallets and categories.
chat.empty_conversation: Nothing said yet in this conversation.
chat.delete_body: It leaves the list along with its messages. Nothing else is affected.
chat.input_hint: Enter sends. Shift and Enter start a new line.
chat.copy_failed: This browser would not let the message be copied.
chat.attachment_missing: That file is no longer in this workspace.
chat.suggestion_food: How much did I spend on food last month?
chat.suggestion_biggest: What is my biggest expense this month?
chat.command_spend_most_month: Show where we spend the most this month

canvas.receipt_description: Nothing is saved until you confirm.
canvas.transaction_description: The receipt stays attached to whatever you create.
canvas.unreadable: That image could not be read. Enter the transaction by hand; the file is already attached.
canvas.failed: The receipt could not be read just now. Try again, or enter it by hand.
canvas.missing: This analysis is no longer in the conversation.

receipt.title: Check this receipt
receipt.subtitle: Every field is editable. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
receipt.corrected_explainer: A recomputed figure did not add up, so the API replaced it and shows what the receipt said. A calculated one the model could not read at all. Check both against the paper.
receipt.breakdown_hint: Subtotal and tax are shown so you can check the total. Only the total is stored.
receipt.items_mismatch: The lines come to {items}, the total says {total}. A service charge explains it; a mistyped line also does.
receipt.currency_mismatch: This receipt is in {receipt} and the wallet holds {wallet}. Pick a wallet in {receipt}, or enter it by hand where a rate can be set.
receipt.queued_title: The reader is busy right now
receipt.queued_body: Your receipt is kept in the Vault as pending. It will be read and saved automatically as soon as the reader is back, and you will see it here. No need to upload it again.
receipt.notice_failed: A pending receipt could not be read: {name}. It is still in the Vault.

auth.name: Name
auth.login_subtitle: Track daily money without manual spreadsheets.
auth.register_subtitle: One account, one workspace to start. Invite others later.
auth.forgot_subtitle: We will email a link if the address is registered.
auth.forgot_sent: If that address is registered, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in one hour.
auth.reset_subtitle: Signing in everywhere else will end.
auth.reset_done: Password updated. Sign in with your new password.

error_page.not_found_description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has been moved.
error_page.unauthorized_description: Your session has ended. Sign in to pick up where you left off.
error_page.forbidden_description: Your role in this workspace cannot open this page. Ask an owner or an admin if you need it.
error_page.unavailable_description: Oewang is busy or being updated. Try again in a minute.
error_page.server_description: We could not finish that request. Nothing you entered was lost; try again in a moment.
error_page.other_description: That request could not be completed.

errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password do not match.
errors.email_taken: That email already has an account.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
errors.insufficient_role: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.not_a_member: You are not a member of that workspace.
errors.last_owner: A workspace must keep at least one owner.
errors.invite_invalid: That invitation is no longer valid.
errors.reset_token_invalid: That reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.wallet_has_transactions: That wallet still has transactions. Move or delete them first.
errors.wallet_currency_locked: A wallet's currency is fixed once it has a transaction.
errors.workspace_currency_locked: The workspace currency is fixed once any transaction exists.
errors.transfer_requires_destination: A transfer needs a destination wallet.
errors.destination_not_allowed: Only a transfer has a destination wallet.
errors.transfer_amount_required: A transfer needs a destination amount.
errors.amount_not_positive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.fx_rate_unavailable: No exchange rate is available. Enter one by hand.
errors.stream_failed: The answer stopped part way. Ask again.
errors.ai_unavailable: The assistant could not be reached. Everything here still works by hand.
errors.extraction_no_answer: The receipt reader didn't answer in time, so this file wasn't read. It may be perfectly clear: try again in a moment, or enter it by hand.
errors.receipt_unreadable: That image could not be read as a receipt.
errors.telegram_disabled: Telegram is not set up on this server yet.

style.title: Design system
style.subtitle: Measured against app.oewang.com, not estimated. Every number below came from getComputedStyle on the live page.
style.focus_note: No focus ring. The live app sets outline:none on :focus and :focus-visible, and this matches it. The cost is in D51.

settings.title: Settings
settings.income_description: Where money comes from. Deleting one clears it from its transactions; the money stays.
settings.expense_description: Where money goes. Deleting one clears it from its transactions; the money stays.
settings.delete_category_confirm: Delete {name}? Transactions keep their money and lose this label.
settings.reorder_hint: Drag to reorder, or press the up or down arrow.
settings.appearance_description: How figures look to you. These colours are yours only; other members keep their own.
settings.color_hint: Every amount also shows its sign, so colour is never the only way to tell income from expense.
settings.assistant_description: What the assistant is told before it reads a single question. Both settings apply to this workspace, from the next message onwards.
settings.instructions_hint: Added to the assistant's instructions on every message, so keep it to standing preferences: how to categorise, which wallet is the usual one, what to call things. It costs a little on each message, which is why it is capped.
settings.instructions_placeholder: Put anything from Tokopedia under Shopping. Use the Cash wallet unless I say otherwise.
settings.instructions_empty: Nothing set. The assistant runs on its own instructions only.
settings.language_hint: Auto answers in the language the question was asked in.
settings.assistant_read_only: Only an owner or an admin can change what the assistant is told. These are the settings in force for this workspace.
settings.assistant_unavailable: The assistant's settings could not be read just now, so they are not shown. Nothing has changed. Reload to try again.
settings.usage_description: What this workspace stores and what the assistant has spent. Recorded and shown, with no limit for now.

txn.backup_device: Back up or restore on this device
txn.empty_description: Add one by hand, or import a statement.
txn.empty_filtered_description: No transaction matches these filters. Clear one, or widen the date range.
txn.delete_confirm: Delete this transaction? The balance it moved is put back.
txn.bulk_delete_confirm: Delete {count} transaction(s)? Every balance they moved is put back.
txn.item_amount_hint: Items do not move a balance. Only the transaction's own amount does.
txn.delete_item_confirm: The transaction keeps its amount. Only the line goes.
txn.receipt_hint: A photo or a PDF. The assistant reads it and you confirm what it found.

import.title: Import transactions
import.subtitle: A CSV from your bank. Four steps, and nothing is written until the last one.
import.wallet_hint: Every row lands in this wallet, in its currency.
import.file_hint: CSV, semicolon or tab separated. Read in your browser; only the text crosses the wire.
import.mapping_pending: Asking the assistant which column holds what.
import.mapping_failed: The assistant could not propose a mapping. Set the columns yourself; nothing else changes.
import.amount_hint: Use one signed amount column, or the debit and credit pair most Indonesian banks export. Figures and dates are read by the API, not here.
import.values_hint: Match the names in the file to categories in this workspace.
import.no_values: No category column is mapped, so there is nothing to match.
import.review_hint: {rows} row(s) from {name} are ready to commit.
import.dropped: {count} malformed row(s) were dropped while reading the file.
import.statement_hint: A photograph or a PDF has no columns to map, so the assistant reads the rows instead. That path is a background job.
import.statement_open: Import a statement image or PDF
import.ai_subtitle: An image or a PDF. The assistant reads the rows; every figure is still parsed by the API.
import.ai_file_hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB. One statement per import.
import.ai_working: Reading the statement. This runs in the background, so you can close this and come back.
import.ai_stale: This import has been running for over ten minutes.
import.ai_stale_hint: The file is still here, so a retry does not upload it again.
import.ai_failed: The import failed. Nothing was written.
import.ai_skipped_hint: A skipped row is one the API could not read or had no exchange rate for. The rest were imported.
import.ai_review_truncated: The list stops after {shown} rows. The counts above cover the whole file.

rates.empty_description: Rates arrive once a day from the rate source. The first snapshot appears after the next refresh.
rates.empty_filtered_description: Try another code, or clear the search and the date.

items.empty_description: Items appear here once a transaction carries line items, for example from a scanned receipt.
items.empty_filtered_description: Try another name, or clear the search.
items.history_description: Every purchase of this item, newest first.
items.history_empty: No purchases found for this item.
items.discount_hint: The receipt for the last purchase had a discount of {amount}. The receipt does not say which item it applied to.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.total_partial: {count} account(s) left out: no rate for their currency today.
accounts.delete_group_confirm: Delete {name}? Its accounts are kept and become ungrouped.
accounts.delete_confirm: Delete {name}? Its transactions must be gone first.
accounts.empty_description: An account holds a balance. Every transaction moves one.
accounts.empty_filtered_description: No account matches this search. Clear it to see them all.
accounts.currency_hint: Defaults to the workspace currency. Locked once the account has a transaction.
accounts.include_in_totals_hint: An account left out still records transactions; it just does not add up.
accounts.balance_hint: Typing a figure records one adjustment transaction for the difference.

files.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 10 MB.
files.unreadable: Those bytes could not be read.
files.error_rejected_type: Accepted: JPEG, PNG, WebP and PDF.
files.error_unsupported_type: Those bytes are not the type claimed.
files.drag_drop: or drag and drop files here
files.upload_hint: Images and PDFs from your computer or Vault
files.preview_unavailable: Preview not available for this file type

apps.unavailable_hint: This server has no Telegram bot configured. An administrator sets TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME.
apps.disconnect_description: The bot stops acting for your account in this workspace. Transactions it saved stay.
apps.empty_connected_description: Connect one from the full list.
apps.telegram_short: Send a receipt photo to save it as an expense, or ask the assistant about your money, from a Telegram chat.
apps.telegram_how_connect: Connect opens a one-time link to the Oewang bot. Scan it with your phone or open it here, then tap Start. The link works once, for ten minutes, and only connects your own account.
apps.telegram_how_receipts: Send a photo or a PDF of a receipt. It is saved as an expense in your default account, with its items, and the reply shows what was saved and this month's total. Tap a category to file it elsewhere, or Delete to remove it.
apps.telegram_how_chat: Write a question and the assistant answers from this workspace, with the same rules as the chat here: it asks before deleting anything, and members can ask but not change.
apps.telegram_how_privacy: Only private chats work, so nobody else in a group can act on your account. Signing out everywhere, resetting your password or leaving the workspace disconnects the chat.
apps.telegram_connect_description: Scan the code with your phone, or open the bot here.
apps.telegram_qr_label: QR code for the Oewang bot link
apps.telegram_connect_footer: Tap Start in Telegram to finish. This link works once and expires in ten minutes.

overview.subtitle_overview: Your money over the selected range
overview.subtitle_metrics: Detailed charts for the selected range
overview.ask_balances: What are my current wallet balances?
overview.ask_monthly: Give a summary of my income vs expenses for {range}.
overview.ask_top: Which category did I spend the most in for {range}?
overview.ask_burn: What is my average monthly burn rate for {range}?
overview.ask_net: How did my net income change for {range} compared with the period before?
overview.ask_balance: What is the total balance across my included accounts right now?
overview.start_failed: The conversation could not be started. Try again.

vault.title: Vault
vault.description: Manage your documents and receipts securely.

empty.title: No files found
empty.no_results: No results for "{search}". Try different keywords.
empty.get_started: Upload your first file to get started.

details.title: File Details
details.missing: This file is no longer in the vault.

delete_confirm.title: Delete {name}?
delete_confirm.description: The file is removed from the vault.
delete_confirm.used: It is attached to {count} transactions and will be removed from them too.

picker.title: Select file
picker.drop: Drag and drop images and PDFs
picker.empty: No vault files found. Upload files in the Vault section first.

vault.receipt_pending_hint: Waiting for the receipt reader. It is saved automatically when the reader is back.
vault.receipt_failed_hint: The reader could not read this receipt. Enter it by hand from Transactions.

workspaces.description: Every workspace you belong to. Choose one to work in, or start a new one.
workspaces.create_description: Add the details so amounts, currency and reports line up correctly across your workspace.
workspaces.dialog_description: Add a new business or project to your account.
workspaces.name_placeholder: Ex: Acme Marketing or Acme Co
workspaces.currency_hint: Locked once the workspace has its first transaction.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: This is how others will see you in your workspaces.
profile.photo_formats: JPG, PNG or WebP. It is cropped to a square.
profile.photo_failed: That photo could not be used.
profile.name_description: Shown to the people you share a workspace with.
profile.email_description: The address you sign in with. It cannot be changed here.

security.title: Password & sessions
security.description: Change your password and see where you are signed in.
security.changed: Password changed. Every other session was signed out.
security.sessions_description: Browsers and devices signed in to your account.
security.logout_all_confirm: Sign out everywhere, this browser included?
security.logout_all_description: You will need to sign in again on every device.
